assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original standalone small enemy sprite for a cinematic realistic-texture 2D side-scroller.
Primary request: one full-body small strawberry-red teddy bear robot with rounded ears, realistic short red plush fur, a dark gray mechanical jetpack and metal joints. Original design, not copying any licensed bear character. Red/pink body with subtle strawberry-colored accents, simple readable face and clear eye. Dark mechanical parts have textured worn steel and brass details suitable for a dark cavern laboratory.
Composition/framing: side view facing RIGHT, compact hovering pose, short legs hanging down, arms relaxed. Full character and whole jetpack visible, centered with at least 10 percent empty transparent margin on every side. Jetpack can look powered but no flames or smoke outside figure.
Lighting/mood: soft cool light from upper-left, moderate exposure, realistic texture readable against a dark environment.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent PNG with true alpha, one isolated character only.
Constraints: no scenery, no floor, no cast shadow onto a backdrop, no painted checkerboard, no text, no letters, no watermarks, no extra characters, no thick outlines. No attack, no projectile.
assets.notes: Visually inspected; complete isolated right-facing character.
